matching_pages_notes: Original PDF pages 371-380 were rendered at 180 dpi and all 460 printed rows were compared with immutable source records for row order, indexed name and initials, rank, private-identifier column occupancy, box, notes, and archive location. Page 372 retains its earlier complete visual review and is intentionally omitted from this bundle's matching-page list so that prior disposition remains authoritative on replay. All nine newly reviewed pages match the current extraction and no correction is needed. The review preserves literal source anomalies and variants rather than silently repairing them, including Pizutto, Plechot, Ponderoyen, Portolos and Portoulas, Pougher Addie G. B., Povnsobhon, Pradzynski, Prifti, Puhpadhana and Pupadhana, Punzirudu, and the Andrew V and Andrew B Puskas rows. It also preserves repeated rows and rank or box variants for Richard F Plunkett, Edward G Posniak, Stanley Potochnik, Davis B Powell, Walter Powers, Edward S Prorok, and Peppino Puleo; the scientific-notation-looking printed forms retained for Benjamin Potts and Thomas Preen; civilian and naval grades such as CAF, P, SP-8, and SP(X); alphanumeric and unusually long private identifiers; and clipped notes such as Extract fr, Also Puc, Also Pou, Also Pov, see fold, and Refer to. Private identifiers are not included in this bundle or public assets.
